<p align="center">Git helper, inspired by cz-git. Pronounced "cesar" (like Julius Cesar!). Written in Rust for speed. </p>

## Goals

- Be a good enough port of cz-git to replace my own committing to this
- Add in-built config support from the CLI instead of editing a weird file
- Learn rust

## Non-goals

- Be a 1:1 port, features may and probably will be missing

## Installation

There's a github releases page with an exe. Build and compile for your platform.

## Usage

`czr` - Runs the tool
`czr config` - Runs config wizard, currently only two configs.
